title: Preparation is proto-perception, measurement is proto-volition

statements.text: In a preparation, events put the subject in a new state and produce a phenomenal quality, a proto-perception. In a measurement, the subject in its state produces an event at the end of a process, which culminates in an action, a proto-volitional act.

sources.quote: The first can be associated with a sensitive process, it produces a phenomenal quality, a proto perception
